items.question: Do I need previous experience in physical theatre or Commedia dell'Arte?
items.answer: No. Each workshop lists its expected level, but many sessions are open to all. The work meets you where you are. What matters most is willingness to play and put yourself on the line.

items.question: What should I wear or bring to a workshop?
items.answer: Comfortable clothing that allows full movement. Soft-soled shoes or bare feet depending on the venue. Everything else -- masks, props, materials -- is provided.

items.question: Can I attend a workshop if I'm not a professional actor?
items.answer: Absolutely. The work is valuable for anyone drawn to physical expression, presence, and play. Theatre-makers, dancers, educators, and curious beginners are all welcome.

items.question: Are scholarships or reduced rates available?
items.answer: We are committed to providing paths of access for practitioners of color, trans theatre-makers, and those from backgrounds not typically represented in the field. Scholarships are available -- please reach out to inquire.

items.question: Can I bring Ivano to my school, studio, or festival?
items.answer: Yes. Ivano regularly leads guest workshops at studios, conservatories, and festivals internationally. Use the contact page to discuss format, duration, and logistics.
